name: 3.3 V LDO regulator (MCP1700-3.3 / AP2112K-3.3)
description: Low-dropout 3.3 V regulator: makes a clean 3.3 V from a higher input (a LiPo, 5 V USB, 3 × AA). VIN from the source, GND to ground, VOUT to the 3.3 V parts; add 1 µF on VIN and VOUT. MCP1700-3.3: 250 mA, 1.6 µA quiescent (best for batteries), ~0.18 V dropout at full load. AP2112K-3.3: 600 mA, ~0.25 V dropout, EN pin (LOW = off; on breakouts it is tied to VIN, so unconnected = on). From a LiPo it holds 3.3 V down to about 3.5 V, then follows the cell down.

pins.label: VIN
pins.description: Input, 2.3 to 6 V (AP2112: 2.5 to 6 V): the battery or 5 V. It needs at least 3.3 V + the dropout to give a full 3.3 V.

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground, shared by input and output.

pins.label: VOUT
pins.description: Regulated 3.3 V output (regulator output) for 3.3 V parts.

pins.label: EN
pins.description: AP2112K only: enable, HIGH = on, LOW = off (unconnected = on, tied to VIN as on breakout boards). The MCP1700 has no EN: leave it unconnected.

props.label: Chip
props.description: Which regulator: sets the current limit, dropout and quiescent current.

footprint: MCP1700-3302E/TO in TO-92 (4.8 × 3.8 mm, 0.1 in legs); AP2112K is SOT-23-5 on a small breakout

bindings.description: "regulating" (3.3 V), "dropout" (input too low: VOUT follows VIN − dropout) or "off".
1 while the output is up (drawing only).

sourcing.generic: 3.3 V low-dropout linear regulator, 250 mA, low quiescent current, TO-92 (MCP1700-3302E/TO); alternative AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5, 600 mA
